checks.title: Confirm search goal and owner
checks.instructions: Record the named owner, canonical website, buyer, offer, market, primary useful visitor action and excluded actions. Decide which source can prove progress; use baseline-first when search data is unavailable.

checks.title: Verify the authorized site scope
checks.instructions: Inspect the approved host and page set, robots and crawl limits, locale and device. Save an actual fetched or exported page reference with observation time. Do not treat a public fetch as proof of indexation.

checks.title: Set buyer-question and metric rules
checks.instructions: Record at least one owner, customer or approved-research buyer question with source and date. Define Search Console property, query/page filters, windows, denominator, freshness and coverage when available; otherwise explicitly mark demand and ranking unknown.

checks.title: Bind two distinct Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect and reuse or create two authorized Crew IDs with selected seo-analyst and search-opportunity-mapper skills. An SEO issue list and a buyer-question map are distinct outputs; one Crew identity does not satisfy both required slots.

checks.title: Test each Crew's source access
checks.instructions: Have SEO Analyst read a bounded real page/crawl source and Search Opportunity Mapper read a real buyer-question source and the same site scope. Record exact account or file, page/query coverage, observation time, missing access and any approved optional Search Console connection.

checks.title: Validate the technical-to-search handoff
checks.instructions: Save an actual seo-issue-list/v1 artifact, run the blocking validator, then save a seo-opportunity-list/v1 linked to the exact issue artifact and rerun validation. Record paths, Crew run IDs and validator output. Confirm a mismatched site, missing issue citation or false publication claim blocks the consumer step.

checks.title: Review the Builder proposal
checks.instructions: Show Crew reuse/creation, access, crawl cost and politeness, source coverage, handoff validator step, owner decision, possible page change and activation policy to the owner. Selecting the Playbook does not authorize execution.

checks.title: Run one bounded case manually
checks.instructions: Use one authorized site/page and buyer question. Record source captures, both Crew run IDs, artifact paths, validator results, owner corrections and blockers. Keep the route manual if a validator is absent or a source/identity check fails.

checks.title: Record the reviewed next action
checks.instructions: Save stable issue/opportunity IDs, exact page and market, technical blocker, owner, approval state, proposed change, retest, success signal and next-check date. Distinguish observed issue, proposed update, approved edit, published page and measured search outcome with separate evidence.

checks.title: Choose manual or recurring policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused schedule with timezone, crawl scope, source freshness, rate limit, budget, retries and notification rules. Do not enable recurrence by completing this check.
